---
name: {{name}}-new
description: Start a change with {{name}} before any code is written. Use when the user wants to build, add, change, fix or clean up something in this repo ("let's build X", "add a feature", "fix this bug", "refactor this").
---
<!-- {{name}}-managed: generated by `{{cmd}} sync`; edits are overwritten -->
1. Run `{{cmd}} status`. If an item is already open for this, continue it with `{{cmd}} next`.
2. Agree on the change type with the user, in plain words: feature (new behaviour), fix
   (wrong behaviour), hotfix (production is broken), refactor (structure only), chore
   (dependencies, config), spike (answer a question). Under ~20 lines with no behaviour
   change needs no item: just commit it as `chore: …`.
3. Run `{{cmd}} new <type> "<short title>"`, then plan it with the user: use the
   {{name}}-plan skill now (it runs `{{cmd}} next` and says how to ask and record decisions).
